name: tinystudio-io
description: TinyStudio public website: the Website Correction ($10,000 per site) on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test:headings && npm run test:sitemap && npm run test:worker && npm run test:appraisal && npm run test:records && npm run test:engagements && npm run test:guardrails && npm run test:payments && npm run test:desk && npm run test:ui && npm run test:contract && npm run test:viewport && npm run test:narrow-pages && npm run test:narrow
scripts.leads:list: wrangler d1 execute tinystudio_email_signups --remote --command "SELECT email, source, page_path, created_at, updated_at FROM email_signups ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100;"
